groups.sentence: Instructors limit or avoid generative AI use, including in introductory courses, when it might undermine learning outcomes.
Students are discouraged from using generative AI tools unless the instructor directs or explicitly allows it.
Students are discouraged from using AI tools to generate content such as text, code, images or audio that ends up in their work.
Students are discouraged from using generative AI tools for coursework, though AI is not banned.
Students are discouraged from using AI as a research or academic source when its output cannot be properly cited or sourced.
Instructors may discourage student use of generative AI by encouraging other tools.
Students use AI cautiously, selectively and thoughtfully, not as a shortcut or a replacement for their own learning.
Everyone avoids generative AI use where it is not suited to the task or leads to excessive reliance.
The institution is reluctant to promote or endorse AI tools and systems.
